notes: Flagged by tools/audit_locators.py because the pinned file is not the one the report's own `# Lines of code` names, then read against the source at the record's pinned commit. Adjudicated by reading, and kept where it is: the report nominates NukeFund.sol, where nuke() requires the token's age to reach minimumDaysHeld and reverts. That check is correct on its own; what makes it revert is TraitForgeNft._beforeTokenTransfer (377-379) resetting lastTokenTransferredTimestamp on every transfer, which the pin names. NukeFund is where the denial is observed, not where it is caused.
